department: Department of Civil, Environmental & Construction Engineering

deadline.value: The department recommends materials by the beginning of January to be considered for financial support.
deadline.quote: highly recommended that your completed material (official transcripts, standard test scores) be submitted by the beginning of January

fee_waiver.value: Under no circumstances can the application fee be waived.
fee_waiver.quote: application fee be waived nor can anything less than official documents be accepted

gre_general.value: The department evaluates GRE score reports as part of each application.

gre_subject.value: No subject test is mentioned on the admissions pages.

supervisor.value: A faculty member must accept the applicant with funding; admission is not granted without full funding.
supervisor.quote: Individual faculty manage their own research funding and as such should be contacted directly to determine a fit to their research program and acceptance with funding.

funding.value: Financial support is limited and competitive, and doctoral students are given preference.
funding.quote: for financial support, but these are limited and competitive

entry_route.value: Most entrants hold an engineering M.S.; applicants without an engineering bachelor's must take leveling courses.
entry_route.quote: Typically, students with M.S. degrees in engineering programs enter the civil engineering doctoral program.

notes: Doctoral tracks: structures, geotechnical, water resources, transportation, construction and environmental.
name: Civil Engineering, Ph.D.
